caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden armchair with a stylized, intricate backrest featuring curved and branched sections forming a fan-like pattern at the top. The chair’s frame is brown, with carved details on the arms and legs. The seat is upholstered with a fabric that has wide vertical stripes in alternating light blue and off-white colors, and is trimmed with a row of evenly spaced metal studs along the lower edge. Below the chair, there is a separate rectangular swatch that displays a fabric pattern of alternating squares: some with small, evenly spaced stars, and others with denser constellations of dots and stars, in shades of light blue and white. The objects are set against an off-white background, bordered by a thin line. There is a signature in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Armchair
